Himachal Pradesh is credited as the first state to adopt a full e-Cabinet (paperless cabinet application, Feb 2021).

notes.text: - **Technology's role in e-governance:** **enhance citizen engagement and improve service delivery** – not replacing people, cutting staff or more control.

exam: APPSC AEE Mains General Studies & Mental Ability 2016
q: The National Award for e-governance in 2015-16 for excellence in Government Process Re-engineering was awarded to the project
explanation: The 2015-16 National Award for e-Governance (Gold) for excellence in Government Process Re-engineering went to COSMOS (Chhattisgarh Online School Monitoring System), Balrampur; MAHA-GEOMIN won in the GIS category. Moved to e-governance programmes.

q: What is the name of the Software used by most of the States for maintenance of Panchayat Accounts?
explanation: PRIASoft (Panchayati Raj Institutions Accounting Software) under e-Panchayat is the accounting software most States use for panchayat accounts.

exam: APPSC AEE General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023
q: The National e-Governance Plan was approved by the Union Cabinet in May ____.
explanation: The National e-Governance Plan (27 MMPs + 10 components) was approved by the Union Government on 18 May 2006.

notes.text: - **First e-Cabinet:** **Himachal Pradesh** (full e-Cabinet, Feb 2021); AP had held an e-cabinet meeting in Sept 2014.

exam: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
q: The vision of the National e-Governance Plan is
options: To provide public services to common man in his locality at affordable cost
To make every one computer literate
To provide public services free of cost right at home
To deliver all public services through online only
key_text: To provide public services to common man in his locality at affordable cost
explanation: NeGP vision: make all government services accessible to the common man in his locality through common service delivery outlets, with efficiency, transparency and reliability at affordable costs; not free of cost or online-only.

exam: APPSC 2025 Welfare Organiser
q: The National e - Governance Plan , 2006 identified how many Mission Mode Projects ( MMPs ) ?
explanation: NeGP 2006 listed 27 MMPs (9 Central, 11 State, 7 Integrated) and 10 components; 31 and 44 (e-Kranti) are later expansions.

notes.text: - **First State Data Centre:** **Himachal Pradesh** (Mehli, Shimla, June 2016; **green** data-centre concept).

q: The eCourt Project, an integrated Mission Mode Project for the ICT development of the Indian judiciary, has been under implementation since which of the following years?
explanation: e-Courts, an Integrated MMP for ICT enablement of the judiciary, has been under implementation since 2007 (Phase I).

exam: APPSC 2023 Screening test (Online Mode) to the post of Deput
q: In February 2024, APAAR was launched by Ministry of Education through Common Service Centres (CSCs) in remote villages of India. What is the full form of APAAR?
explanation: APAAR = Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry ('One Nation One Student ID'), launched by the Ministry of Education through CSCs in February 2024.

exam: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
q: National Digital Repository to store, index, preserve, distribute and share the digital learning resources developed by the Open and Distance Learning Institutions in the country is known as?
explanation: eGyanKosh (IGNOU) is the national digital repository for learning resources of Open and Distance Learning institutions; Gyandarshan and Gyanvani are TV and radio channels.

exam: APPSC Assistant Director of Fisheries in A.P. Fisheries Serv
q: What is the name of the web portal launched by Survey of India on the 250th Anniversary?
explanation: Survey of India launched the 'Nakshe' web portal (free downloadable topographic maps) on its 250th anniversary in 2017. Off-topic for AP ICT, moved to e-governance portals.

exam: APPSC Group-IV Paper-I Mains 2023
q: Which of the following statements about the 'Amantran' portal launched by Rajnath Singh in January 2023 is INCORRECT?
options: It will be used to extend e-invitations to dignitaries/guests and for the online sale of tickets to the general public for witnessing Republic Day and Independence Day events.
It contains QR code-based authentication for enhanced security.
Passes/tickets will be delivered digitally through emails/sms.
The passes/tickets can be easily cancelled/transferred.
key_text: The passes/tickets can be easily cancelled/transferred.
explanation: The Aamantran portal (MoD, 6 Jan 2023) sends e-invitations and sells Republic Day/Independence Day tickets with QR-code authentication and digital delivery by email/SMS; its tickets are non-cancellable and non-transferable, so statement d is the incorrect one. (PIB says it was launched by Raksha Rajya Mantri Ajay Bhatt, not Rajnath Singh.)

exam: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening
q: The Government-led initiative in India that provides a secure online platform to store and share digital documents is
explanation: DigiLocker (MeitY, Feb 2015) is a secure cloud locker to store and share digital documents, linked to Aadhaar.

notes.text: - **DigiLocker:** **MeitY**, **February 2015** – secure personal space to **store and share digital documents**, linked to **Aadhaar**; DL and RC linked with MoRTH (Sept 2016); **56.06 crore** users.
